description: Superpose the APG-6 AlphaFold model on yeast Atg8 (2ZPN) and test whether the Atg19 WEEL AIM fits the APG-6 pockets without steric clashes
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
from collections import defaultdict
os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(txt):
    at=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            at.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(), res=ln[17:20].strip(), chain=ln[21], seq=int(ln[22:26]),
                           x=float(ln[30:38]), y=float(ln[38:46]), z=float(ln[46:54]),
                           b=float(ln[60:66]), el=(ln[76:78].strip() or ln[12:16].strip()[0])))
        elif ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
    return at

meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8WZY7",timeout=60).json()[0]
print("AFDB entry:",meta["modelEntityId"],"| global pLDDT",meta["globalMetricValue"],"| created",meta["modelCreatedDate"])
pdb_url=meta.get("pdbUrl"); print("pdbUrl:",pdb_url)
af=parse_pdb(requests.get(pdb_url,timeout=90).text)
af_seq={a['seq']:AA3.get(a['res'],'X') for a in af}
plddt={a['seq']:a['b'] for a in af if a['name']=='CA'}
print("AF residues:",min(af_seq),"-",max(af_seq),"| mean pLDDT %.1f"%np.mean(list(plddt.values())))

z=parse_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2ZPN.pdb",timeout=90).text)
atg8A=[a for a in z if a['chain']=='A']; pepE=[a for a in z if a['chain']=='E']
print("2ZPN:A residues", min(a['seq'] for a in atg8A),"-",max(a['seq'] for a in atg8A),
      "| AIM peptide:", "".join(AA3[a['res']] for a in pepE if a['name']=='CA'))

caA={a['seq']:np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]) for a in atg8A if a['name']=='CA'}
caQ={a['seq']:np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]) for a in af if a['name']=='CA'}
common=sorted(set(caA)&set(caQ))
P=np.array([caQ[i] for i in common]); Q=np.array([caA[i] for i in common])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
rms=np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
print(f"\nCA superposition APG-6 (AlphaFold) -> yeast Atg8 (2ZPN:A): {len(common)} atoms, RMSD = {rms:.2f} A")

Rinv=R.T; tinv=-R.T@t
pep=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in pepE])
pep_apg6=(Rinv@pep.T).T+tinv
heavy=[a for a in af if a['el']!='H']
AC=np.array([[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']] for a in heavy])
D=np.sqrt(((AC[:,None,:]-pep_apg6[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
md=D.min(0)
clash=int((md<2.2).sum()); cont=int((md<4.5).sum())
print(f"Atg19 WEEL AIM rigid-placed into the APG-6 frame: {len(pep)} heavy atoms")
print(f"  severe clashes (<2.2 A): {clash}")
print(f"  atoms in contact (<4.5 A): {cont}/{len(pep)}")
print(f"  closest approach {md.min():.2f} A, median min-dist {np.median(md):.2f} A")

near=defaultdict(lambda:1e9)
for i,j in zip(*np.where(D<=4.5)):
    k=(heavy[i]['seq'],AA3.get(heavy[i]['res'],'X')); near[k]=min(near[k],D[i,j])
pocket=sorted(near)
expected={17,21,28,30,31,48,49,50,51,52,55,60,63,67,104}
got={r[0] for r in pocket}
print("\nAPG-6 residues lining the docked AIM:", ", ".join(f"{r[1]}{r[0]}" for r in pocket))
print(f"  recovered {len(got&expected)}/15 crystallographic contacts; extra {sorted(got-expected)}; missed {sorted(expected-got)}")

print("\npLDDT, C-terminal region:")
for i in range(108,max(af_seq)+1): print(f"  {af_seq[i]}{i}: {plddt[i]:.1f}")
core=np.mean([plddt[i] for i in range(1,112)]); tail=np.mean([plddt[i] for i in range(117,122) if i in plddt])
pk=np.mean([plddt[i] for i in sorted(expected)])
print(f"mean pLDDT: core 1-111 = {core:.1f} | AIM-pocket residues = {pk:.1f} | propeptide 117-121 = {tail:.1f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
xs=sorted(plddt); ys=[plddt[i] for i in xs]
ax.plot(xs,ys,color="#2b4c7e",lw=1.6)
ax.axhspan(90,100,color="#1f6f4a",alpha=.10); ax.axhspan(70,90,color="#c8922a",alpha=.10)
ax.axvspan(116.5,121.5,color="#9b8ec4",alpha=.35)
for p in sorted(expected): ax.plot([p],[plddt[p]],marker="o",ms=4,color="#c0392b")
ax.plot([116],[plddt[116]],marker="*",ms=13,color="#e8a33d")
ax.annotate("Gly116",xy=(116,plddt[116]),xytext=(92,42),fontsize=9,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#b8761a"))
ax.annotate("117-DFETA-121",xy=(119,plddt[119]),xytext=(66,20),fontsize=9,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#6b5fa8"))
ax.set_xlabel("APG-6 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence for APG-6\nred = AIM-docking residues, shaded = propeptide",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(md,bins=np.arange(0,12.5,0.5),color="#2b4c7e",edgecolor="white")
ax.axvline(2.2,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1.5); ax.axvline(4.5,color="#1f6f4a",ls="--",lw=1.5)
ax.set_xlabel("min. distance to nearest APG-6 heavy atom (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("AIM peptide heavy atoms")
ax.set_title(f"Atg19 WEEL AIM placed in the APG-6 frame\n{clash} clashes, {cont}/{len(pep)} atoms in contact, CA RMSD {rms:.2f} A",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(dict(residue=[f"{r[1]}{r[0]}" for r in pocket], min_dist_to_AIM_A=[round(near[r],2) for r in pocket],
                  pLDDT=[round(plddt[r[0]],1) for r in pocket])).to_csv("out/apg6_AF_docked_AIM_pocket.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved out/apg6_AF_docked_AIM_pocket.csv")
